UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User account profile and activity record in Daily Earn Pro

uid.description: Unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user

displayName.description: Display name or handle of the user

role.description: Role of the user, e.g. user or admin

createdAt.description: ISO string timestamp when account was registered

lastLoginAt.description: ISO string timestamp of the last login session

designsCreatedCount.description: Total number of designs exported or created

addedAt.description: Timestamp when admin status was granted

AppStats.title: AppStats
AppStats.description: Aggregated application usage statistics for the admin dashboard

totalDesignsCreated.description: Total poster, thumbnail, and caption creations across all users

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profiles. Accessible only by the owner user and verified system administrators.

/admins/{adminId}.description: List of authorized administrator UIDs. Used by security rules to enforce Zero-Trust RBAC.

/app_stats/{statId}.description: Global usage metrics and app stats. Readable only by verified administrators.
